label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: Something is NECESSARY_1: some being cannot not-be
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., tertia via: Non ergo omnia entia sunt possibilia: sed oportet aliquid esse necessarium in rebus
interpretation: Something cannot not-be. The move from 'not all can not-be' to 'something is necessary' uses excluded middle, stated as a premise (STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE).
